description: This Java class defines Swagger documentation data structures for the DataTables API in the Fineract project, including request and response schemas for operations like retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting data tables.

classes.name: DatatablesApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger schemas for DataTables API requests and responses.

classes.name: GetDataTablesResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response of retrieving DataTables information.

classes.name: PostDataTablesRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new DataTable, including nested column header data.

classes.name: PostDataTablesResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a DataTable.

classes.name: PutDataTablesRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating a DataTable, including nested structures for dropping, adding, and changing columns.

classes.name: PutDataTablesResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after updating a DataTable.

classes.name: DeleteDataTablesResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after deleting a DataTable.

classes.name: PostDataTablesRegisterDatatableAppTable
classes.description: Schema for registering a DataTable application table (empty class).

classes.name: PostDataTablesAppTableIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for a request to create or update data in a specific table instance.

classes.name: PostDataTablesAppTableIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating or updating data in a table instance.

classes.name: GetDataTablesAppTableIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving a specific data table instance, including headers and data rows.

classes.name: PutDataTablesAppTableIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after updating a specific data table instance.

classes.name: PutDataTablesAppTableIdDatatableIdResponse
classes.description: Schema similar to above, for a specific datatable ID.

classes.name: DeleteDataTablesDatatableAppTableIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for deleting a data table instance.

classes.name: DeleteDataTablesDatatableAppTableIdDatatableIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for deleting a specific data table by ID.
